phases.description: Foundation Phase - Core infrastructure with no cross-epic dependencies
Configuration Phase - Authentication and enterprise config
UI Phase - Interactive TUI and mode detection
Core Task Phase - Central task management
Automation Phase - Yolo mode and JSON output

features.name: File-based JSON Storage
features.description: Atomic file operations for global state, workspace state, task history, and secrets with file locking for concurrent access
features.prompt: Implement the foundational file-based JSON storage system for the Cline CLI GoLang migration. Create ClineFileStorage struct with atomic file operations using file locking (flock). Support paths: ~/.cline/data/globalState.json, ~/.cline/data/secrets.json, ~/.cline/data/workspaces/{hash}/workspaceState.json. Implement thread-safe read/write with sync.RWMutex and atomic writes (temp file + rename). Handle permissions (0600 for secrets, 0644 for state). Files: internal/storage/storage.go, file_storage.go, storage_test.go, file_storage_test.go.

features.name: Secrets Encryption
features.description: Encrypt secrets using OS keyring integration before storage in secrets.json, decrypt on read
features.prompt: Implement secrets encryption using OS keyring. Integrate with macOS Keychain (github.com/keybase/go-keychain), Linux Secret Service (github.com/zalando/go-keyring), Windows Credential Manager (github.com/danieljoos/wincred). Use AES-256-GCM encryption. Implement fallback to file-based encryption with warning. Files: internal/storage/secrets.go, secrets_test.go.

features.name: State Migration
features.description: Automatic migration from legacy state formats with version tracking and backward compatibility
features.prompt: Implement state migration system with version tracking. Create migration registry with version-to-function mapping. Implement migrations from TypeScript CLI formats. Support atomic migration with backup/restore. Use __storageVersion field. Files: internal/storage/migration.go, migration_test.go.

features.name: gRPC Client Implementation
features.description: Generate Go code from proto definitions and implement gRPC client for core extension communication
features.prompt: Implement gRPC client for Cline core extension. Generate Go code from proto/cline/*.proto using protoc-gen-go and protoc-gen-go-grpc. Implement connection management, pooling, reconnection logic. Support TLS. Use google.golang.org/grpc. Files: internal/grpc/client.go, client_test.go, generate.go.

features.name: Bidirectional Streaming
features.description: Handle bidirectional message streaming between CLI and core extension with flow control and reconnection
features.prompt: Implement bidirectional streaming for gRPC communication. Handle streaming message flow, flow control, backpressure. Support partial message streaming. Implement reconnection on failure. Use goroutines and channels. Files: internal/grpc/stream.go, stream_test.go.

features.name: State Synchronization
features.description: Synchronize state bidirectionally between CLI and core extension with conflict resolution
features.prompt: Implement state synchronization between CLI and core. Support bidirectional sync with conflict resolution (last-write-wins). Implement optimistic updates with rollback. Use event-based sync with state versioning. Files: internal/grpc/state_sync.go, state_sync_test.go.

features.name: Root Command with Default Task Mode
features.description: Cobra root command that detects if prompt is provided and routes to interactive or task mode
features.prompt: Implement root command using Cobra. Detect prompt argument for routing to task or interactive mode. Support global flags: --config, --verbose, --version, --help. Initialize logging. Use github.com/spf13/cobra and viper. Files: cmd/cline/main.go, root.go, root_test.go.

features.name: Task Subcommand with Flags
features.description: Task subcommand with all flags: mode (-a, -p), yolo (-y), timeout (-t), model (-m), images (-i), verbose (-v), cwd (-c), config (--config), thinking (--thinking), json (--json), taskId (-T)
features.prompt: Implement task subcommand with all flags: -a/--act, -p/--plan (mutually exclusive), -y/--yolo, -t/--timeout, -m/--model, -i/--image (multiple), -v/--verbose, -c/--cwd, --config, --thinking, --json, -T/--taskId. Validate flag combinations. Handle image attachments. Files: cmd/cline/task.go, task_test.go.

features.name: History Subcommand with Pagination
features.description: History subcommand with limit (-n) and page (-p) flags for browsing task history
features.prompt: Implement history subcommand with -n/--limit (default 10), -p/--page (default 1), --config flags. Load from ~/.cline/data/taskHistory.json. Implement pagination with offset/limit. Format as table or list. Support --json. Files: cmd/cline/history.go, history_test.go.

features.name: Config, Auth, Update, Version, Dev Subcommands
features.description: Additional subcommands: config (display settings), auth (authentication wizard), update (check for updates), version (show version), dev (debug logs)
features.prompt: Implement utility subcommands. Config: display global/workspace state, --json, --edit. Auth: interactive wizard with -p (provider), -k (key), -m (model), --test. Update: check npm registry, --check-only. Version: show version, build date, commit. Dev: log (show/tail), doctor (diagnostics). Files: cmd/cline/config.go, auth.go, update.go, version.go, dev.go with tests.

features.name: OpenAI Provider
features.description: OpenAI API integration with streaming response handling and token usage tracking
features.prompt: Implement OpenAI API provider. Support chat completions endpoint with streaming (SSE). Track token usage. Support GPT-4, GPT-3.5. Handle errors, rate limiting. Support Azure OpenAI custom base URL. Use net/http with bufio.Scanner for SSE. Files: internal/providers/openai.go, openai_test.go.

features.name: Anthropic Provider
features.description: Anthropic Claude API integration with streaming response handling
features.prompt: Implement Anthropic Claude API provider. Support messages endpoint with streaming. Track tokens. Support Claude 3, 3.5. Handle thinking blocks. Use net/http with SSE parsing. Files: internal/providers/anthropic.go, anthropic_test.go.

features.name: OpenRouter Provider
features.description: OpenRouter multi-provider routing with unified response format handling
features.prompt: Implement OpenRouter provider. Support unified API for multiple providers. Handle model routing (provider/model format). Implement fallback logic. Support custom headers. Files: internal/providers/openrouter.go, openrouter_test.go.

features.name: Other Providers (Gemini, Bedrock, etc.)
features.description: Additional provider implementations: Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and other supported providers with unified interface
features.prompt: Implement additional providers: Google Gemini (AI Studio API), AWS Bedrock (AWS SDK), Ollama, LM Studio. Use unified provider interface. Support streaming where available. Handle provider-specific auth. Files: internal/providers/gemini.go, bedrock.go, other_test.go.

features.name: OAuth Authentication Flows
features.description: OAuth flow implementation with local callback server for providers supporting OAuth (browser open, token capture, secure storage)
features.prompt: Implement OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE. Start local HTTP callback server. Open browser for authorization. Capture and exchange tokens. Securely store using secrets encryption. Handle errors gracefully. Support token refresh. Use golang.org/x/oauth2. Files: internal/auth/oauth.go, server.go, oauth_test.go.

features.name: API Key Management
features.description: API key validation, testing, and secure storage with interactive and flag-based input
features.prompt: Implement API key management. Support interactive input with masking (golang.org/x/term) and flag-based input (-k). Validate key format per provider. Test with provider API. Store encrypted using secrets. Support key rotation. Files: internal/auth/apikey.go, apikey_test.go.

features.name: Provider Configuration Wizard
features.description: Interactive wizard for provider selection, model selection, and configuration validation
features.prompt: Implement interactive configuration wizard. Step-by-step flow: provider selection, auth method selection, credentials input, model selection, validation, save confirmation. Support non-interactive mode with flags. Use github.com/AlecAivazis/survey or similar. Files: internal/auth/wizard.go, wizard_test.go.

features.name: Configuration Layering
features.description: Tiered configuration loading: global state, workspace state, environment variables with proper precedence
features.prompt: Implement configuration layering. Precedence: defaults < global state < workspace state < environment variables (CLINE_*) < CLI flags. Use github.com/spf13/viper. Support workspace-specific settings. Merge configurations. Files: internal/config/layer.go, layer_test.go.

features.name: Policy Enforcement
features.description: Enterprise policy definitions and enforcement for allowed models, API key rotation, and usage restrictions
features.prompt: Implement policy enforcement. Support allowed/denied models lists, API key age limits, usage quotas. Enforce during configuration. Log violations. Support policy inheritance and hot-reload. Files: internal/config/policy.go, policy_test.go.

features.name: Bubble Tea TUI Framework Setup
features.description: Initialize Bubble Tea program with Model-Update-View loop, terminal dimension handling, and keyboard event processing
features.prompt: Implement Bubble Tea TUI framework. Initialize program with Model-Update-View architecture using github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea. Handle terminal dimensions, keyboard events, window resize (SIGWINCH). Support both TUI and plain modes. Implement graceful shutdown. Files: internal/ui/tui.go, model.go, update.go, view.go, tui_test.go.

features.name: Chat Message Rendering Components
features.description: Message bubble rendering with markdown formatting, syntax highlighting, and streaming message display
features.prompt: Implement chat message rendering. Message bubbles with github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss. Markdown formatting with glamour. Syntax highlighting with chroma. Streaming message display with partial updates. Support message types: say, ask, text, tool_use, tool_result, error. Files: internal/ui/chat.go, message.go, markdown.go, chat_test.go.

features.name: User Input Handling and Prompts
features.description: User input capture, text input fields, approval/rejection prompts, and keyboard shortcuts
features.prompt: Implement user input handling. Text input with github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles/textinput. Multi-line with textarea. Approval/rejection prompts. Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+C/q (quit), Ctrl+A/y (approve), Ctrl+R/n (reject), arrows (navigate), Enter (submit). Input history. Files: internal/ui/input.go, prompt.go, input_test.go.

features.name: Welcome Screen and Onboarding
features.description: First-time user detection, welcome screen rendering, quick start hints, and recent task display
features.prompt: Implement welcome screen. First-time user detection. Welcome banner with lipgloss styling. Quick start hints. Recent tasks display. Authentication status. Skip welcome option. Handle terminal size constraints. Files: internal/ui/welcome.go, welcome_test.go.

features.name: TTY/Redirect Detection
features.description: Automatic detection of interactive vs non-interactive mode using isatty checks on stdin and stdout
features.prompt: Implement TTY/redirect detection. Use golang.org/x/term for isatty checks on stdin, stdout, stderr. Detect piped input and output redirection. Support explicit override flags and CLINE_FORCE_TTY environment variable. Files: internal/mode/detect.go, detect_test.go.

features.name: Mode Switching Logic
features.description: Switch between interactive TUI and plain text output modes based on detection results and explicit flags
features.prompt: Implement mode switching. Strategy pattern for mode-specific behavior. Initialize appropriate handlers (TUI or plain). Support modes: Interactive (Bubble Tea), Plain (text output), JSON (structured). Support force flags: --interactive, --plain, --json. Files: internal/mode/switch.go, switch_test.go.

features.name: New Task Initialization
features.description: Initialize new tasks with prompt, images, mode selection, model preference, and working directory handling
features.prompt: Implement new task initialization. Generate UUID task IDs. Load and validate images. Load configuration. Establish gRPC stream. Send NewTask request. Initialize UI. Persist to history. Set working directory. Files: internal/task/init.go, init_test.go.

features.name: Task Resumption by ID
features.description: Resume existing tasks by ID with conversation history loading and optional follow-up message
features.prompt: Implement task resumption. Load task by ID. Load conversation history. Validate task state. Establish gRPC stream. Send ResumeTask with optional message. Restore UI conversation. Support --continue for most recent task. Files: internal/task/resume.go, resume_test.go.

features.name: Conversation History Management
features.description: Store and load conversation messages with pagination and large conversation handling
features.prompt: Implement conversation history management. Message storage with pagination (offset/limit). Handle large conversations with truncation. Message serialization matching proto definitions. Support conversation search and export. Efficient loading with lazy pagination. Files: internal/task/conversation.go, conversation_test.go.

features.name: Tool Approval Workflows
features.description: Display tool requests, capture user approval/rejection, execute tools, and return results with yolo mode support
features.prompt: Implement tool approval workflows. Display tool requests (read_file, write_file, execute_command, etc.). Capture approval/rejection via UI prompts. Execute approved tools. Return results via gRPC. Support yolo mode (auto-approve). Handle errors and timeouts. Files: internal/task/tools.go, approval.go, tools_test.go.

features.name: Yolo Mode Implementation
features.description: Auto-approve all tool executions, suppress confirmation prompts, and run tasks to completion without user intervention
features.prompt: Implement yolo mode. Handle -y/--yolo flag. Auto-approve all tool requests. Suppress confirmation prompts. Run to completion. Return exit codes (0 success, non-zero failure). Log all actions. Support JSON output. Files: internal/auto/yolo.go, yolo_test.go.

features.name: Command Permission Validation
features.description: Validate commands against CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS allow/deny lists with glob pattern matching
features.prompt: Implement command permission validation. Parse CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS JSON. Implement allow/deny lists with glob matching. Validate compound command segments (&&, ||, ;). Deny takes precedence. Support allowRedirects flag. Detailed error messages. Files: internal/auto/permissions.go, permissions_test.go.

features.name: JSON Output Formatting
features.description: Serialize messages to JSON format with required and optional fields for machine-readable output
features.prompt: Implement JSON output formatting. Serialize all message types. Required fields: type, text, ts. Optional: reasoning, say, ask, partial, images, files. Support --pretty for pretty-printing. Error output in JSON format. Deterministic output with sorted keys. Files: internal/output/json.go, json_test.go.

features.name: JSON Streaming for Long Tasks
features.description: Stream JSON lines in real-time as messages arrive with partial message handling
features.prompt: Implement JSON streaming. Stream JSON lines (JSONL) as messages arrive. Handle partial message updates with partial flag. Flush immediately for real-time output. Handle streaming termination. Each line valid JSON. Files: internal/output/stream.go, stream_test.go.

features.name: Permission Rule Parsing
features.description: Parse CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS JSON environment variable with allow, deny, and allowRedirects rules
features.prompt: Implement permission rule parsing. Parse CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS JSON with allow, deny, allowRedirects fields. Validate JSON schema. Handle missing config (default allow-all). Cache parsed permissions. Descriptive error messages. Files: internal/security/parse.go, parse_test.go.

features.name: Command Validation Engine
features.description: Validate commands against permission rules with deny precedence and segment validation
features.prompt: Implement command validation engine. Validate against permissions with glob matching. Deny precedes allow. Validate compound command segments. Detailed validation results. Cache decisions. Log validation. Files: internal/security/validate.go, validate_test.go.

features.name: Dangerous Character Detection
features.description: Detect dangerous characters in commands: backticks outside quotes, unquoted newlines, subshells
features.prompt: Implement dangerous character detection. Detect backticks (`cmd`) outside single quotes. Detect subshells $(...) outside single quotes. Detect unquoted newlines. Respect single quotes (disable inside). Double quotes do NOT disable. Detailed results. Files: internal/security/danger.go, danger_test.go.

features.name: Audit Logging
features.description: Log all actions (command execution, file edits, API calls) with timestamps and user context
features.prompt: Implement audit logging. Log: command_execution, file_read, file_write, api_call, tool_approval, tool_rejection, configuration_change. Include UTC timestamps, user context, task ID, session ID. Structured JSON logging with log/slog. Support log rotation. Async logging. Files: internal/audit/log.go, log_test.go.

features.name: Compliance Report Generation
features.description: Generate compliance reports from audit logs with date range filtering and export formatting
features.prompt: Implement compliance report generation. Generate from audit logs. Date range filtering. Event type filtering. Export formats: JSON, CSV, summary. Handle large reports with streaming. Files: internal/audit/export.go, export_test.go.

features.name: Independence Verification
features.description: Verify GoLang CLI contains no embedded JavaScript/TypeScript, no Node.js dependencies, and produces single static binary
features.prompt: Implement independence verification. Verify no embedded JS/TS in binary. Verify no Node.js dependencies. Verify static binary. Check no imports from cli/src/. Check no npm dependencies. Generate verification report. Fail build if dependencies found. Files: scripts/verify_independence.sh, verify_test.go.

features.name: Cross-platform Build Scripts
features.description: Cross-compilation for Linux (amd64, arm64), macOS (amd64, arm64), Windows (amd64) with binary signing
features.prompt: Implement cross-platform build scripts. Cross-compile for: linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, windows/amd64. Sign macOS binaries (codesign). Generate checksums. Create release archives. Support version tagging. Files: scripts/build.sh, Makefile, build_test.go.

features.name: Homebrew Formula
features.description: Generate and publish Homebrew formula for macOS/Linux installation via brew install cline
features.prompt: Implement Homebrew formula generation. Generate formula from template. Calculate SHA256 checksums. Support macOS (amd64, arm64) and Linux (amd64, arm64). Create tap structure. Versioning support. Files: scripts/homebrew.rb, generate_homebrew.sh.

features.name: NPM Wrapper Package
features.description: Create npm package that downloads correct platform binary with postinstall script for npm install -g cline
features.prompt: Implement NPM wrapper package. Create package.json. Postinstall script downloads correct binary for platform (process.platform, process.arch). Verify checksum. Set executable permissions. Support proxy configuration. Handle errors. Files: npm/package.json, install.js, README.md.
